theory.title: Habla de tus aficiones y del tiempo libre
theory.explanation: Usa like, love y enjoy para hablar de actividades que te gustan. Después de estos verbos, cuando mencionas una actividad, usa el verbo terminado en -ing: I like reading. Para expresar una preferencia puedes decir My favourite hobby is... Aprende las actividades antes de practicar las frases.
theory.tip: Con I, you, we y they usamos like/love/enjoy. Con he y she añadimos -s: She likes dancing. En la forma negativa básica usamos don't like: I don't like singing.

What question asks about a favourite hobby?
When does Leo have free time?
What does Leo enjoy listening to?
Who takes photos in the park?

content.passage: My name is Leo and I live in Leeds. I have free time after school. I like reading adventure books. I also enjoy listening to music in my room. On Saturdays, I go cycling with my friend Sam. Sam loves taking photos in the park. My sister Mia likes painting and drawing. She doesn't like watching films. Our favourite hobby is cooking together on Sundays. We make simple food and listen to music.

content.audioTranscript: Hi, Leo. What do you like doing after school? I like reading and listening to music. What do you do on Saturday? I go cycling with Sam. Does Sam like taking photos? Yes, he does. My sister Mia likes painting, but she doesn't like watching films. We enjoy cooking together on Sunday. It is our favourite hobby.
